title: A reporter identity lets another install's Master file items and messages here, and nothing else
description: On the real control plane over a temporary Postgres, a principal of role reporter, holding only GRAPHYARD_URL and a token file in a directory that is not a checkout, creates an item with the CLI and gets its key; the item is unreleased, in backlog and attributed to the reporter. Its message to this install's Master appears once in master status attention naming the sender; after the Master replies, the reporter reads back its item's stage and the reply. The same principal is refused with a plain reason on release, close, requirements, priority, claim, complete, evidence, registry and lesson, and cannot read another item.

steps.name: reporter files, messages, reads back and is refused the rest
